audio_clips.text: In soft sunlight, a hand caresses young leaves on a vine.
Water pours from a rusty outdoor pump.
Someone washes their hands, droplets flying off and catching the sun.
Drones glide above a vineyard, watering the vines.
a figure in tall leather boots.
they stride slowly between the vines.

Jean-Luc Picard raises his chin to look at us. His face is soft with age and jowled, but his eyes are piercing.
Deep Space, words on screen. Star Trek Picard. Coming soon.
